question: From Figure 2B-1, identify the shapes of the STOP and YIELD signs and the color scheme of the ALL-WAY plaque.
model_answer: Direct Answer: In Figure 2B-1, the STOP (R1-1) sign is an octagon (red background with white legend and border), and the YIELD (R1-2) sign is a downward-pointing (inverted) equilateral triangle with a red border and white interior. The ALL-WAY (R1-3P) plaque has a white legend and border on a red background. Standards (mandatory): - "At intersections where all approaches are controlled by STOP signs (see Section 2B.12), an ALL-WAY (R1-3P) supplemental plaque (see Figure 2B-1) shall be mounted below each STOP sign. The ALL-WAY plaque shall have a white legend and border on a red background." - "When it is determined that a full stop is always required on an approach to an intersection, a STOP (R1-1) sign (see Figure 2B-1) shall be used." - "The YIELD (R1-2) sign (see Figure 2B-1) shall not be displayed using a changeable message sign." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 2B-1 shows the R1-1 STOP sign as a red octagon with white legend and border, the R1-2 YIELD sign as a red downward-pointing triangle with a white interior containing the red word "YIELD," and the R1-3P ALL-WAY plaque as a horizontal red rectangle with white legend and border. - [Image 2] The full page containing Section 2B.04 and Figure 2B-1 confirms the octagonal STOP sign, triangular YIELD sign, and the red ALL-WAY plaque with white legend and border. - [Image 3] This page (Figure 7B-1) shows the same octagonal STOP and triangular YIELD symbols reproduced within school-crossing signs, consistent with the shapes in Figure 2B-1. - [Image 4] This page (Figure 6G-1) shows the R1-1 octagonal STOP sign and R1-2 triangular YIELD sign used in temporary traffic control zones, matching the Figure 2B-1 shapes. - [Image 5] This page (Figure 2B-20) shows octagonal STOP signs in intersection signing layouts, consistent with the R1-1 shape in Figure 2B-1. Citations: - Section 2B.04 Standard §4 (p.74) - Section 2B.04 Standard §1 (p.74) - Section 2B.05 Standard §2 (p.75) - Figure 2B-1 (p.74)
gold_answer: STOP is an octagon; YIELD is a downward-pointing equilateral triangle; the ALL-WAY plaque has white legend and border on a red background.
